method.source: Complete local clone; frozen remote head SHAs; no branch-name comparisons after snapshot.
method.application_scope: apps/ and packages/, excluding .md/.txt; runtime data, tests, styles and package configuration included.
method.engineering_scope: Application scope plus scripts/, tools/, deploy/ and .github/, excluding .md/.txt.
method.blob_retention: Donor-changed paths compare exact Git mode/type/blob tuples with target; deletions compare missing entries. No similarity heuristic or 300-file API cap.
method.patch_equivalence: git cherry target head compares nonmerge patch IDs. Squashed/composed behavior can be present even when commit patch IDs differ.
method.multiple_merge_bases: For criss-cross histories, compare every best merge base and retain the conservative union of changed paths, with individual counts. No arbitrary merge base is selected; this is not a simulated merge result.
method.limits: Neither patch uniqueness nor differing blobs proves unique behavior. Target changes may supersede old code. Semantic review and combined-source qualification are separate. PR and ref reads are not one atomic snapshot.

details.content: Full changed-path arrays and equivalent/unique commit SHA lists for every comparison. gzip mtime=0; UTF-8 JSON.
